## Boundary questions

Answer each yes or no. A yes names the site, and the change either routes it through the
engine or marks it with a `mirrors: <clause id>` comment
(`assurance.structure-tree.mirror-exemption`).

- Does the engine already do this? yes / no
- Does a surface re-implement a policy the registered view compiles in? yes / no
- Does a second state model mirror one the engine owns? yes / no
- If the engine changed tomorrow, would this surface silently disagree? yes / no
